schema: Phase 1 backup-and-freeze manifest (Master Spec Section 19/16). The actual backed-up data (~1.7GB) lives locally, uncommitted, at backup_location - Section 16 forbids committing raw runtime archives. This manifest is the small, git-committed record of what exists there and its integrity hashes.

freeze_confirmation.watchdog_loop_stopped: scripts/watchdog-loop.ps1 process killed; its Startup-folder shortcut (Tradysquid Watchdog.lnk) moved to Startup-disabled/, not deleted - reversible
freeze_confirmation.restart_loop_stopped: START-SUPERVISOR.cmd batch loop exited cleanly via its own designed stop switch, state/supervisor-stop.flag (created, not a code change)
freeze_confirmation.verified_stopped: no discord_command_bot/local_information_engine/run_supervisor_simple/ngrok process running, port 8876 has no listener, confirmed after a 20+ second settle window
freeze_confirmation.note: Tradysquids Supervisor.cmd (a separate, older Startup-folder entry) still exists but points at C:\Users\strea\OneDrive\Desktop\Tradysquid-main, which no longer exists on disk - dead, harmless, left as-is

reversal_path: Enable-ScheduledTask for the 5 tasks above, remove state/supervisor-stop.flag, move Tradysquid Watchdog.lnk back from Startup-disabled/ to Startup/, then run START.cmd or START-SUPERVISOR.cmd once.
excluded: No .env or credential-VALUE files found in any backed-up source tree (checked before backup). state/credential-migration.json and state/post-migration-credentials.json were included - both explicitly record secret_values_written: false and contain only env-var key names, not secret values.
